en.title: Kuma Choco - Hot Chocolate Drink
en.describe:
Look, I took a page out of the barista playbook—turns out, there’s a whole craft behind making a drink look like more than just a liquid. It’s about the aesthetic precision.

I was originally going to execute a cat design, but I pivoted to a bear. It’s a solid, classic look. Also, full disclosure: this isn’t coffee. It’s a hot chocolate. Sometimes you just want something high-quality and straightforward without the caffeine.

Next Drawing Progress FanArt TV Anime Series Character & Game Character :

Mordred (Saber)
AKA: Knight of Treachery / 「叛逆の騎士」 Hangyaku no Kishi / The Knight of Londinium / Saber of Red

In Game Gacha RPG: Fate/Grand Order, Mordred is one of the 5-star saber class servants with an anti-army type of noble phantasm, and is quietly hard to summon.

Default Biography:
Mordred is a Knight of the Round Table and the legitimate child of King Arthur.
At the same time, the one who put an end to the legend-- at Camlann Hill, the Knight of Rebellion who slew King Arthur.

More details at the Anime TV Series: Fate/Apocrypha:
She can be successfully summoned by her master Shisigo Kairi 「獅子劫 界離」, as a necromancy using an ancient relic and catalytic bonding with his late daughter.
Mordred was summoned as a tomboy young girl. The most impressive of her is her armor, which is mechanical like a human-sized Gundam suit.

Be happy, because of on this occasion, I decided to draw Saber of Red set the hair still loose and with cute expression.

en.title: Poka the Adventurer
en.describe:
My Story :
I'm Poka 「ポカ」 Poca, as you see I'm an adventurer.

This summer, I'm taking what's mine: a vacation to explore a semi-arid desert. Low rainfall? No problem – I'll be the vivid splash of color, the rainbow in that landscape.

My journey is all about the flow; no set destination, just me and the asphalt, and I'll be resting for a few days in any village or settlement that accepts me. This is going to be a seriously long haul. I live for challenges, and this is exactly how I own my identity as an adventurer.

So, wish me luck!
